name: Thit heo hun khoi
summary: Thịt heo hun khói is smoked pork, sold among the weekend market’s dried foods and at the center stall as a provincial three-star OCOP product.
howToEat: A visitor at the market calls it thịt hun khói. It is a different product from heo làng nướng.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square.
The market’s center stall sells the provincial three-star OCOP smoked pork, smoked beef, and smoked buffalo, with wine products and specialty salt.
seoTitle: Smoked pork in Mang Den — thịt heo hun khói
seoDescription: Thịt heo hun khói, smoked pork and a three-star OCOP product, at the Mang Den weekend market.
